prompt: Help me study for an APUSH exam, we will be talking about period 8, the post WW2 period from 1945-1980.
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 gives a broadly coherent APUSH Period 8 overview with mostly accurate event/topic coverage (Cold War, civil rights milestones, wars, and key political/legal developments). Candidates 2–4 contain multiple major factual errors—e.g., misdating/incorrect framing of NATO and the MLK “Mountaintop” speech (Cand. 2), major event/location/date mix-ups like the Berlin Wall and “I Have a Dream” (Cand. 3), and several severe inaccuracies such as Korean War “unification,” incorrect details about the Cuban Missile Crisis, and “US victory” in Vietnam (Cand. 4). Because these errors significantly undermine the usefulness for studying, Candidate 1 is clearly best.
